summary.en: Missing item: Mrs. Kaetsu's brooch While at his office, Kogoro receives a request from Kanae Kaetsu, a client whose mother's brooch was stolen. They have to follow letters left by the robber to find out the truth. Target: Kanae Kaetsu Attack types: Car ramming While on the road to the second location said by the robber, a car approaches them and tries to ram them, but fails to as Kogoro manages to move themselves aside. Target: Kanae Kaetsu Attack types: Falling flower pot At the third location, the duo avoid at the last minute a falling flower pot. Target: Kanae Kaetsu Attack types: Flying golf ball While going out of the fourth location, Kogoro catches a flying ball directed towards them. Nagakura murdered a diet member he hated two years ago. He was found out and arrested by Kogoro. Nagakura committed suicide before his trial began in prison.
